title: fix(console): a fresh self-hosted install leads with the owner account, says sign-up errors inline, and says each Home item once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5wTMBYnJxUKFAQRGQW3UQh)_

Part of #32021

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：全新自托管、一个账号都没有时，登录页不再说「欢迎回来」，而是以「设置此部署 / 创建所有者账号」开头；注册表单不再弹浏览器气泡，长度不足和两次密码不一致一次性在各自字段下用当前语言显示；首页「未配置邮件」和「连接 AI 助手」各只说一次，部署提醒与清单同宽（1120px）；清单的助手一项改说「连接外部 AI 助手（MCP）」；服务器没有邮件发送时，密码错误提示改为「请联系管理员为你重置」；中文里语言/国家名按界面语言显示，「经身份服务写入」改为「账号系统」，AI 设置页的 Embedder/Trace/Prompt/PII 译为 向量化/请求追踪/提示词/个人敏感信息。
- 为什么改：#32021 在全新安装上实测的六个首次使用问题；第一位访客被当作老用户、注册错误要试好几轮才看全、首页同一件事说两遍、无邮件时还承诺「重置后立即登录」。
- 风险与回滚：登录/注册页现在对所有开放注册的形态都会请求一次 `GET /api/v1/auth/bootstrap-status`（以前只在 invite_only 下请求）；探测失败时保持「欢迎回来」，不会误显示首个所有者引导。部署提醒的内容和可见范围未改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx`（`firstOwner`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/homeItemClaims.ts`（谁让谁）、`ui/packages/auth/src/RegisterForm.tsx`（`handleSubmit` 一次收集全部字段错误）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/signUpFollowsPosture-11691.test.tsx packages/auth/src/__tests__/registerMismatchFieldError-25885.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`，应全绿；截图见下方 Verification。
- 需要你做的：两件需要你拍板，见 Acceptance notes 的 A（内置 AI provider 清单项缺可读信号，建议另开 domain:server 子卡）和 B（生产首装时「你的应用」标题在 1440×1000 的首屏底部，应用图标仍在首屏下方约 60px）。

## What changes

**1. A box nobody has an account on leads with creating the owner account.** The signal is the one that already switches the card's footer between "Sign up" and "Have an invitation?": `GET /api/v1/auth/bootstrap-status` → `hasOwner`. The console `LoginPage` now runs that probe for every posture that offers a sign-up form to a visitor not invited (app-shell `needsOwnerProbe`), not only `invite_only`. A new `useBootstrapProbe` returns the old `status` plus `noOwner`, which is true only on an explicit `hasOwner: false`; a failed or unreadable probe leaves it false, so the page says "nobody has an account here yet" only on the server's word and otherwise keeps "Welcome back". With `noOwner` the card is titled "Set up this deployment", leads with a "Create the owner account" button over an "or sign in to an existing account" divider, and drops the small "Sign up" link (one way to the sign-up, never two). The register page reads the same probe and is titled "Create the owner account". An invitation redirect is greeted for the invitation as before and makes no probe.

**2. Sign-up says every problem inline, at once, in the page's language.** `RegisterForm` is `noValidate`, so the browser's one-at-a-time bubble (in the browser's language) is gone, and `handleSubmit` collects every field error before returning: empty name, empty or malformed email, too-short password and mismatch, each drawn under its own field with `aria-invalid` / `aria-describedby`. A short password that also does not match shows both together. Three new labels (`nameRequiredError`, `emailRequiredError`, `emailInvalidError`) carry the new messages and the console passes them from the pack. The auth config serves no minimum length, so the form keeps 8. The banner still carries server and captcha refusals.

**3. Home says each item once.** A small page-scoped store (`homeItemClaims.ts`) lets a Home card say "I am drawing this item now":
- `mail`: the deployment notice claims it while it draws its email line on Home. What the notice says and who sees it are ruled (#30120, ruling A3), so it never yields; the checklist's Email delivery row stands aside meanwhile and comes back when the notice is hidden, absent (outside production) or has no email finding.
- `connect_assistant`: the checklist claims it while it draws its Connect row not yet done; Home's Connect an AI Assistant card stands aside meanwhile. Members get no checklist, so they still see the card.

The notice's Home width goes from `max-w-7xl` to the 1120px the rest of Home uses, and the checklist sits closer under the header (`pt-7` → `pt-4`).

**4. The checklist's assistant row** is now "Connect an external AI assistant": "Work in this system as yourself from Claude, Doubao and similar assistants, over MCP. The built-in AI is set up separately, in Setup → AI & Embedder." No in-product AI provider step: see Acceptance note A.

**5. A wrong password with no mail transport points to the administrator.** The readable signal is the public auth config's `features.emailDelivery` (the same answer the invitation toast reads to know mail is not configured). When it is `false`, `signInRefusalMessages(t, { emailDelivery })` maps `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` to the new `auth.login.errors.invalidCredentialsNoMail` ("… Forgot your password? Ask your administrator to reset it."). `true` or absent keeps the reset hint. Applied to the console login form, its dev-admin row, and app-shell's `DefaultLoginPage`.

**6. zh-CN wording.** The checklist names the current language and country with `Intl.DisplayNames` in the reader's language (「当前为美国英语、美国」, no English fragment), falling back to the option label. The managed-by note says 「由内置账号系统维护」 instead of 「经身份服务写入」. Setup → AI & Embedder: 向量化 for Embedder (page, group, API key, test button, nav), 记录请求追踪 for Trace, 提示词 for Prompt, 个人敏感信息 for PII. Labels only; the provider default is #31960 (landed as #32010), not here.

Kept as they were: the inline sign-in error, the footer switching "Sign up" → "Have an invitation?", automatic zh-CN, the invitation toast, the ruled deployment notice's content and gate, and LoginPage's "⛔ The password is never rendered …" comment.

## Tests

One pin per shipped item, through the real component, each with its CONTROL:

- `apps/console/.../signUpFollowsPosture-11691.test.tsx` (real `AuthProvider` over a real `createAuthClient` and a stub server), new describes:
  - under `open` and `invite_only` with `hasOwner: false`: "Set up this deployment", the owner button to `/register`, no small "Sign up", the form still there; clicking through reaches "Create the owner account";
  - CONTROL: a box with an owner keeps "Welcome back" and the "Have an invitation?" hint (invite_only) or the small "Sign up" (open); a probe the server fails (500) keeps "Welcome back"; an invitee on an ownerless box is greeted for the invitation;
  - no mail: a typed wrong password with `features.emailDelivery: false` shows `invalidCredentialsNoMail`; CONTROL: `true` and absent keep `invalidCredentials`.
  - Four existing pins moved with the change: the open/email_domain and no-posture cases now see the one owner probe, and the ownerless invite_only case now expects the owner button instead of the small link.
- `packages/auth/.../registerMismatchFieldError-25885.test.tsx`, new describe: the form is `noValidate`; `张伟` / `123` / `456` shows the length and mismatch messages together and sends nothing; an empty submit marks name, email and password; `zhang` is refused under email; translated labels flow through; CONTROL: a complete form is sent with nothing marked.
- `packages/app-shell/.../DeploymentNotice.test.tsx`: the notice claims `mail` while its email line is drawn on Home and releases it on hide; every finding is still drawn; CONTROL: no email finding, System Overview, and a member claim nothing.
- `packages/app-shell/.../ConnectAssistantCard-30895.test.tsx` §7: the card stands aside while the checklist row is drawn and comes back when it goes; CONTROL: no row, card shown.
- `apps/console/.../FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`: the mail row is left out while `mail` is claimed and returns on release; the open assistant row claims `connect_assistant`, a done row and a member's page do not; zh names 英语/美国 with no "English"/"United States" (CONTROL en); the assistant row's new wording.
- `packages/app-shell/.../loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx`: `DefaultLoginPage` under zh with `emailDelivery: false` shows the zh no-mail text; CONTROL `true` keeps the reset hint.
- `ManagedByBadge.keyboard-27521.test.tsx`: the zh note no longer contains 身份服务.
- The sixteen console login/register test files built on a mocked auth client now get one module-scope double for `/bootstrap-status` (`src/__tests__/helpers/ownerProbeDouble.ts`, `hasOwner: true`, handed back in `afterAll`), because the widened probe otherwise reached a real socket and the network-escape guard turned them red.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree, red then restored with `git diff HEAD` empty:

| # | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 no-users branch | console `LoginPage`: `firstOwner = … && ownerProbe.noOwner` → `… && false` | 4 of 23 in signUpFollowsPosture (both first-owner leads, the click-through, the ownerless invite_only pin) |
| A2 no-mail branch | `signInRefusalMessages`: `context.emailDelivery === false` → never true | 2 of 30 (console no-mail pin, `DefaultLoginPage` zh no-mail pin) |
| A3 collect-all | `RegisterForm`: mismatch only when the length passed | 2 of 9 (short + mismatch together, translated labels) |
| A4 notice claim | `DeploymentNotice`: mail claim → `false` | 1 of 41 (the claim/release pin) |

## Acceptance notes

**A. Item 4 ships the wording only (hence `Part of #32021`).** A built-in AI provider step needs a provider state the Console can read faithfully, and there is none: service-ai auto-detects its provider from environment variables (for example an `OPENAI_API_KEY` with no `OS_AI_PROVIDER`), which the `ai` settings namespace does not reflect, so `provider: null` (#32010) does not mean "the built-in AI is off". A step drawn from that read would show "not set up" on a box whose AI works. Reported as a `domain:server` child in the os-dev report: serve the effective provider (and its source) read-only, then the checklist can add the step.

**B. "Your apps" and the fold.** On a production first boot (all five notice findings) at 1440×1000, the checklist (6 rows, mail row yielded) ends at y=540 and the notice at y=841; the "Your apps" heading sits at y≈954, inside the fold, and the app tiles start just below it. On a dev boot (no notice) the tiles are well inside. Getting the tiles above the fold on a production first boot would need a layout decision (for example collapsing the checklist or the notice by default, or moving apps above them); both cards' content is required as is, so this PR does not make that call.

**C. Not changed, on purpose.** app-shell's exported `DefaultLoginPage` gets the no-mail text but not the first-owner lead (the Console page is the one the order names). `SetupPage` still uses native validation. Its zh-Hant settings pack still says Embedder (item 6 is zh-CN).

**Deviations from the claimed file surface.** Touched beyond the order's list: `bootstrapStatus.ts`, `signUpOffer.ts`, app-shell's `LoginPage.tsx`/`RegisterPage.tsx`/`index.ts`, `packages/auth/src/RegisterForm.tsx`, the new `homeItemClaims.ts`, and translation-only lines in `@objectstack/service-settings` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`. None of #31988's files (`createAuthClient.ts`, `types.ts`, `AuthContext.ts`, `AuthProvider.tsx`, `CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`) are touched.

## Verification

- vitest (under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`): `ui/apps/console` 309 files / 3117 tests pass; `@object-ui/auth` 46 / 413; `@object-ui/i18n` 100 / 1843 (13 skipped); `@objectstack/service-settings` 75 / 1441; `@objectstack/platform-objects` `src/apps` 39 / 798; app-shell's auth, home, deployment-notice, connect and ManagedByBadge tests pass. The full app-shell suite (2,224 files) did not finish on this 4-core box within the run limit (stopped after about 41 minutes with no failure reported); CI's sharded run covers it.
- type-check: `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `ui/apps/console` — all four pass (console after the full build).
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (2 en values changed, followed by all 10 packs), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: pass.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 70 derived, all 70 run and exit 0 (one, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, first exited 3 on the shallow clone and passed after `git fetch --unshallow`); `--ran`: `70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Browser (`pnpm dev -- --fresh --no-seed-admin`, `hasOwner: false`, `audiencePosture: invite_only`, `emailDelivery: false`; and an `os start` production first boot), shots in the project's `ui-orders/32021-shots/`:
  - `1-login-no-users-{en,zh-CN}`: "Set up this deployment" / 「设置此部署」 with the owner button;
  - `2-register-inline-errors-{en,zh-CN}`: 「密码至少需要8个字符」 and 「两次输入的密码不一致」 together, form `noValidate`;
  - `3-home-{en,zh-CN}` (dev): checklist with the mail row (no notice outside production), assistant row drawn and card yielded, 「当前为美国英语、美国」;
  - `3-home-production-{en,zh-CN}`: notice with its email line and checklist both 1120px wide, no mail row, no assistant card;
  - `5-login-wrong-password-{en,zh-CN}`: after the owner exists, "Welcome back" / 「欢迎回来」 and the administrator hint.
